_comment: Performance budget for the PR-only CI gate (FINAL §2 / RC2 Fix 5). The PR workflow NEVER deploys. Hard runtime targets: LCP < 2000ms, CLS < 0.05, TBT < 200ms, plus an initial-JS-size ceiling (jsMax, bytes over the wire). The two JS-heavy layouts (/ and /kundali) carry documented ratchet ceilings (current measured + small headroom) so the gate blocks REGRESSIONS while the TBT/JS debt is driven down; lower these as below-the-fold is deferred and the chart bundle is split. jsMax ceilings are set from the local build:dev measurement.
